text:
Which statements about the effect of increasing the temperature on the rate of a reaction are
correct?
1
It increases the rate of a reaction.
2
It increases the activation energy.
3
It increases the frequency of collisions.
A
1, 2 and 3
B
1 and 2 only
C
1 and 3 only
D
2 and 3 only
subject: Chemistry
